input:
; Target-neutral relational program rows derived from the checked program.
; One checked rule is one map-shaped operator until later lowering splits joins,
; filters, aggregates, and feedback into separate operator identities.
(: DbspEmitter (*))

(: dbsp_relation
   (* (: relation type)
      (: arity int)))

(: dbsp_operator
   (* (: rule any)
      (: head type)
      (: classification text)))

(: dbsp_read
   (* (: rule any)
      (: position int)
      (: polarity text)
      (: relation type)))

(: dbsp_projection
   (* (: rule any)
      (: position int)
      (: argument any)))

(: dbsp_call
   (* (: rule any)
      (: role text)
      (: position int)
      (: call any)
      (: relation type)))

(: dbsp_argument
   (* (: call any)
      (: position int)
      (: argument any)))

(: dbsp_argument_edge
   (* (: argument any)
      (: label any)
      (: target any)
      (: index int)))

(emits DbspEmitter "relations" dbsp_relation)
(emits DbspEmitter "operators" dbsp_operator)
(emits DbspEmitter "reads" dbsp_read)
(emits DbspEmitter "projections" dbsp_projection)
(emits DbspEmitter "calls" dbsp_call)
(emits DbspEmitter "arguments" dbsp_argument)
(emits DbspEmitter "argument_edges" dbsp_argument_edge)

(<- (dbsp_relation ?Relation ?Arity)
    (program_relation ?Relation ?Arity))

(<- (dbsp_operator ?Rule ?Head ?Kind)
    (program_rule ?Rule ?HeadCall)
    (program_rule_kind ?Rule ?Kind)
    (program_apply ?HeadCall ?Head))

(<- (dbsp_read ?Rule ?Position ?Polarity ?Relation)
    (program_goal ?Rule ?Position ?Polarity ?Call)
    (program_apply ?Call ?Relation))

(<- (dbsp_projection ?Rule ?Position ?Argument)
    (program_rule ?Rule ?HeadCall)
    (program_argument ?HeadCall ?Position ?Argument))

(<- (dbsp_call ?Rule "head" 0 ?Call ?Relation)
    (program_rule ?Rule ?Call)
    (program_apply ?Call ?Relation))

(<- (dbsp_call ?Rule ?Polarity ?Position ?Call ?Relation)
    (program_goal ?Rule ?Position ?Polarity ?Call)
    (program_apply ?Call ?Relation))

(<- (dbsp_argument ?Call ?Position ?Argument)
    (program_argument ?Call ?Position ?Argument))

(<- (dbsp_argument_edge ?Argument ?Label ?Target ?Index)
    (program_edge ?Argument ?Label ?Target ?Index))
